# Browser-side libraries for the markdown preview page, pinned and checksummed.
#
# Format:  <sha256>  <path relative to this directory>  <url>
#
# Versions are EXACT on purpose. The upstream plugin's page requests these at
# floating ranges (mermaid@11, markdown-it@14, highlightjs@11, morphdom@2), which
# means every future release of every package is inside the trust boundary of a
# page that renders local files and holds the preview session token. Pinning plus
# a recorded hash makes each bump a reviewable diff instead of a silent update.
#
# Populate or verify with:  fetch-md-preview-vendor
# Bump a version:           edit the URL, run with --update, review, commit.
#
# Deliberately NOT vendored:
#   @mermaid-js/layout-elk  -- its ESM build code-splits into separate chunks;
#                              keep `mermaid_elk = false` (the default) instead.
#   @iconify-json/*         -- upstream fetched these per-document from unpkg
#                              based on markdown content; that call is removed
#                              from our index.html rather than vendored.
